name: Recon: Subdomain Enumeration (amass)
description: Uses OWASP Amass to discover subdomains for a given domain, then filters for live hosts using httpx.

steps.name: Enumerate Subdomains
steps.description: Run amass to discover subdomains for the target domain.

steps.name: Filter Live Subdomains
steps.description: Use httpx to check which of the discovered subdomains are live.
argsTemplate: SUBDOMAINS_FILE=/tmp/subdomains_$(date +%s).txt && echo '{{step1_enum_subdomains.evidence.data.subdomains}}' | tr ',' '\n' | grep -v '^$' > $SUBDOMAINS_FILE && if [ -s $SUBDOMAINS_FILE ]; then   httpx -l $SUBDOMAINS_FILE -silent -json 2>/dev/null || echo 'httpx probe complete'; else   echo 'No subdomains found from step1, skipping httpx probe'; fi

emptyOutputExplanation: amass 子域名枚举仅适用于公网域名目标（如 example.com）；对本地 IP（127.0.0.1）或 DVWA 靶机无效，输出为空属于预期行为
teachingObjective: 演示使用 amass 对公网域名进行子域名枚举和 OSINT 侦察
